rows.passage_en: Merge sort recursively sorts two halves and merges them in linear time. Its worst-case recurrence is T(n)=2T(n/2)+O(n), giving O(n log n) time.
rows.review_note: Conventional comparison implementations are intended; quicksort has quadratic worst cases. General source rule, not a quoted solution.

rows.passage_en: IPv4 permits fragmentation when a datagram is too large for a later network link. The destination reassembles the fragments; the source need not always send packets exactly equal to the smallest path MTU.
rows.review_note: The do-not-fragment flag can forbid fragmentation; the question says may, not must. Verify endpoint-only language against full RFC before approval.

rows.source_locator: Proof Complexity; companion Beame section2.3 Resolution
rows.passage_en: Propositional resolution is sound and refutation-complete. Nevertheless, some unsatisfiable formula families require exponentially long resolution refutations.
rows.review_note: Soundness/completeness additionally checked in https://www.cs.cmu.edu/afs/cs/project/jair/pub/volume22/beame04a-html/node7_ct.html . Extended resolution must not be confused with ordinary resolution.

rows.passage_en: An expression grammar can place multiplication inside the operands of addition, so multiplication binds more tightly. Such syntax rules express operator precedence without requiring type checks.
rows.review_note: Researcher explanation from actual nested expression productions; identifier length is normally lexical, type compatibility semantic. Final check should inspect productions, not just precedence table.

rows.passage_en: Finite-precision arithmetic can lose information during rounding. In general, changing parentheses changes which intermediate values are rounded, so floating-point addition is not associative.
rows.review_note: Independent counterexample in binary double: (1e16 + -1e16)+1 = 1 whereas 1e16+(-1e16+1)=0. Rounding conventions do not restore universal associativity.

rows.source_locator: section2.6 execution context; calculation derived from supplied assignments
rows.passage_en: Parallel assignments must preserve data dependencies: an operation that needs a newly computed value must wait for that value, and an old value must be read before another operation overwrites it.
rows.review_note: Independent schedule: time1 assignment1; time2 assignments2,3,4; time3 assignments5,6. Chain1->3->5 gives lower bound3. Source is background execution context, not source of this scheduling theorem; replace with explicit dependence source before final approval.

rows.source_locator: direct mapping and Understanding Cache Performance
rows.passage_en: A direct-mapped cache gives each memory block one possible cache location. Alternating between different blocks assigned to the same location can repeatedly evict useful data and cause conflict misses.
rows.review_note: Source explicitly distinguishes conflict, capacity and compulsory misses.

rows.passage_en: A conventional process has separate stack and heap regions. Procedure-call stack frames keep information such as local variables, arguments, and return state; the dynamically allocated heap is a separate area.
rows.review_note: Heap pointers may be local values in a frame, but that does not place the heap area itself inside that frame.

rows.passage_en: The common divisors of two nonzero integers are exactly the divisors of their greatest common divisor. If six is a common divisor, three must also be a common divisor. Zero cannot divide a nonzero integer.
rows.review_note: For gcd6 the signed divisors are {-6,-3,-2,-1,1,2,3,6}. Pairs involving a zero still have divisors of the nonzero member; pair(0,0) has infinitely many divisors, not any finite offered set. Proof is researcher derived.

rows.passage_en: Each edge can reduce the number of connected components by at most one. A component on k vertices can hold at most k(k-1)/2 edges in a simple undirected graph.
rows.review_note: Minimum components10-6=4 is attained by a forest. To maximize components, six edges fit on four vertices as K4 plus six isolated vertices, giving7. Eight components would leave at most3 edges (one K3), so7 is maximal. Background reference supports counting only; proof is independent.

rows.passage_en: Deadlock requires a cycle of processes holding resources while waiting for others. A fixed ordering of resource acquisition breaks circular wait. Reordering waiting processes by priority alone does not release resources already held.
rows.review_note: D random restarts assume held resources are released and randomized retries; unlike priority queue order this can break a deadlock. Source provides necessary conditions and ordering method.

rows.passage_en: Each active procedure invocation needs its own local state and return information. Recursive invocations can be nested to a depth that is not fixed at compile time, so a single static frame per procedure cannot generally hold all active calls.
rows.review_note: Conventional stack-versus-static model in the question; heap-based continuation implementations are possible and not contradicted. New JVM frame per invocation explicitly documented.

rows.passage_en: Round-robin scheduling gives each runnable job a turn for a finite time slice before returning it to the queue. Repeated turns prevent a continuously runnable job from being ignored indefinitely.
rows.review_note: Assumes finite runnable population at a time and a fair maintained queue. A continuing supply of favored/shorter/newer jobs can starve other policies listed.

rows.passage_en: A finite binary fraction is an integer divided by a power of two. A reduced rational fraction has a terminating binary expansion only when its denominator has no prime factors other than two.
rows.review_note: Independent reductions: 1/10,1/5,3/10 contain factor5;1/2 is exactly binary0.1. General criterion derived from positional notation, not quoted.

rows.source_locator: syntax-notation background; independent derivation of supplied grammar
rows.passage_en: For these productions, B generates one or more x characters, while C generates either more x characters, a single y, or zy. Therefore A can generate only x strings, x strings followed by y, or x strings followed by zy.
rows.review_note: A -> BC, B -> x+, C -> x+|y|zy. Thus xyz is impossible: a z cannot end a sentence. xy,xxzy,xxxxy are derivable. Source only illustrates grammar notation; result follows directly from question productions.

rows.passage_en: Memory-mapped device registers occupy addressable locations. A processor accesses them through memory access operations, although device memory may require special ordering and access rules.
rows.review_note: Do not imply device registers behave identically to ordinary RAM; Linux documentation distinguishes memory-mapped IO from port IO.

rows.source_locator: finite arithmetic background; independent block-cost calculation
rows.passage_en: For nonoverlapping costs, total read time is their sum. Reading a fixed-size file in larger blocks reduces the number of per-operation fixed costs, while keeping the total byte-dependent cost unchanged.
rows.review_note: Independent calculation: 1000-byte block25+8+1+1+10=45ms;4000-byte block25+8+4+4+10=51ms. Same4000 bytes costs180ms old,51ms new; ratio51/180=.28333, about1:3.53. Background source not published exact solution.

rows.passage_en: Polling can be useful when an event will finish quickly. If waiting may take time and another task can run, an interrupt lets the operating system do useful work instead of repeatedly checking the device.
rows.review_note: Time-sharing is a reason to yield or block, not by itself a justification for monopolizing the processor in a busy loop.

rows.passage_en: A tracing garbage collector starts with roots such as active stack variables, parameters, registers, and globals. It follows their references to discover reachable heap objects rather than treating every allocated heap object as a root.
rows.review_note: Collector variants can add roots, but the question specifies typical reachability collection. Parameter copies and stack variables are covered by active variables.

rows.passage_en: Virtual memory can keep only some pages in physical memory and store others elsewhere. This lets the virtual address space exceed available RAM; pages are fixed-size storage units rather than semantic program structures.
rows.review_note: The physical-memory claim is supported directly; fixed-size page distinction also needs paging chapter in final source review.

rows.passage_en: Eight-bit signed magnitude and ones complement represent integers from -127 to 127. Eight-bit twos complement represents -128 to 127. A sum within the relevant range does not overflow that representation.
rows.review_note: 109+(-42)=67, with both inputs and result in all three ranges. Representation ranges independently derived from7magnitude bits and signed binary weighting; CWE defines overflow, not these exact ranges.

rows.passage_en: To decode an eight-bit twos-complement value, subtract 256 from its unsigned value when the top bit is one. Addition overflows when the mathematical sum falls outside -128 through 127.
rows.review_note: Independent option sums: A=-1+1=0;B=1-128=-127;C=-1-127=-128;D=-127-86=-213, outside range. No key relabeling.

rows.passage_en: An input/output device can raise a hardware interrupt when an operation finishes. The operating system handles the interrupt and can wake the process that was waiting for the operation.
rows.review_note: Only says can: not every IO completion requires its own interrupt. Source also discusses coalescing and polling.

rows.source_locator: cache write-policy background; independent store count
rows.passage_en: A write-through policy propagates each store to the next memory level instead of waiting for later cache eviction. With one four-byte array-element store per loop iteration, the written data is four bytes per iteration.
rows.review_note: 256 iterations x4 bytes =1024. Count requested data bytes, not block-fill reads or bus metadata. Final source check must locate write-through section explicitly.

rows.passage_en: A high-level source program can be translated through compilation and assembly into machine instructions represented as bits. High-level notation generally makes the program easier for people to read.
rows.review_note: GCC establishes translation pipeline; readability is ordinary comparison for this educational item, not an empirical universal claim about all source programs.

rows.source_locator: What To Do if You Suspect a Phishing Attack
rows.passage_en: When checking a suspicious message, contact the company using a phone number you already know is genuine. A number printed on your bank card is independent of links and contact details supplied in the message.
rows.review_note: Comparative least likely item, not a guarantee every message directing a call is safe. FTC explicitly recommends independent trusted contact information.

rows.source_locator: On the reliability of mechanisms; testing by sampling
rows.passage_en: Running a program on many test cases can reveal errors, but passing those cases does not establish that every possible execution is correct. Untested inputs and execution paths can still contain bugs.
rows.review_note: Own concise factual paraphrase; not a quotation of the famous slogan. Source explicitly explains limits of sampling tests.

rows.passage_en: Processing larger inputs depends on how execution time and memory use grow with input size. Counting source statements alone does not determine those costs: a short loop can execute many times.
rows.review_note: Independent reasoning using a constant-size loop versus an unrolled finite computation; the source supports input-growth analysis, not an exact solution or claim that code length never matters.
